blocks.text: Jao Mapa recalled his brief romance with Rosanna Roces, which began around the time they worked together on the 1997 film “Matrikula.” Mapa made the revelation during a recent interview with Susan Enriquez for her YouTube program “Kay Susan Tayo!” When Enriquez asked Mapa about his past showbiz relationships and whether he had a “The One That Got Away” (TOTGA), he named Roces.
